capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Performance Battery: 79.2 kWh gross (Porsche). Pack for this trim: named in the trim. Same pack 2020-2024 (no change reported across those years).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Wikipedia lists 71 kWh usable for the Performance Battery. Porsche's own pages give gross only.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Porsche names only "pouch cells" (battery page); The Weekly Driver lists the Taycan 79.2 and 93.4 kWh packs as NMC (LG Energy Solution). Third-party, not a Porsche statement.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Porsche: "system voltage of 800 volts instead of the usual 400 volts".

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: combines two Porsche pages, each covering half: the range-planner page ("the system also regulates the preconditioning of the battery in good time before the charging stop") and the Porsche US Charging Planner page (planner preconditions the battery; needs route guidance, no manual trigger; Taycan 2020 to present). Charging Planner regulates battery preconditioning before the charging stop while navigating (Porsche newsroom); Porsche US support page applies it to Taycan 2020 to present. No manual battery-preconditioning button found (a departure timer preconditions battery and cabin for the plug-in case).

dc_max_kw.notes: Porsche: up to 225 kW with the Performance Battery (225 / 270 split; 5-80% in 22.5 min). Hardware 2020-2024; the 320 kW rating starts with the 2025 refresh.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: North American standard on-board charger 9.6 kW (InsideEVs 2025 table; Porsche 2022 retrofit page says the 19.2 kW kit halves 9.5 h to 4.8 h, i.e. previous charger about 9.6 kW). Same charger assumed 2020-2024; no 2020-24 page stating the standard charger was found. 9.6 kW is the standard North American charger; 19.2 kW (and 22 kW per the Porsche 2021 European release) are options. 19.2 kW is a US option (KB4, 2022 onward; retrofit for older cars), 11 kW standard in Europe. Canada assumed equal to the US.
